exposure: combination of breastfeed and bottle-feed in the first month of life
mothers wrongly considering formula milk healthier than breastfeed
cohort: The study comprised 250 mother-child dyads who initiated breastfeeding at birth but discontinued it before 24 months of age.
finding: Significant predictors of shorter breastfeeding duration included pacifier use, combined bottle-feeding and breastfeeding in the first month of life, and mothers wrongly considering formula milk healthier than breastfeed.
